craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-vīra of maker named; vyabhicāri śamotsāha at considered gracious maker. Sanskrit-first: mātṛsthiti per UNC (kept); vicārya (CONSIDERED — kept; thought shines first, maker second). Rows: 1 (‘blessed’ closes — dhanyā last: blessing seals), 9 (split/shines/stands — difference split, thought shines, knower stands). Close: ‘my death-loosing maker, blessed’. Rupture: period (shining stated, then considered — goddesses split, I consider). Rejected: ‘lord’ for maker — killed: maker makes (kartṛ kept); ‘Enough’ cut — killed: alam seals the shining (enough IS the close of L1). Read aloud: SO by-GOD-dess-es, DIFF-er-ence-GLO-ry SPLIT at-ONCE — THOUGHT-liv-ing-ONE shines, KNOW-er-STAND-ing. E-NOUGH … my-DEATH-loos-ing MA-ker, BLESS-ed.

lines: So by goddesses, difference-glory split at once — thought-living one shines, knower-standing. Enough.
Considered in my own heart, dissolution-formed, gracious be she — my death-loosing maker, blessed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ devībhiḥ sapadi dalite bhedavibhave | mṛtyupralayakaraṇī me bhagavatī
